note: Actual participation, honestly reported. Six roles were requested: coordinator, adversary/methodology reviewer, two independent mechanism designers, closest-prior-work reviewer and mathematical/implementation verifier. All six were filled by separate agents except the coordinator, which was the main session. One additional read-only helper compiled the closed-lane facts as a coordinator aid. Durations are from the agents' completion notices (wall-clock, LLM time, not local CPU). Local numerical work by agents ran through the campaign queue and is in RESOURCE_INVENTORY.json.
